Namaste! Is video series mein hum CCS Leave Travel Concession Rules 1988 ke Rules 1 se 6 samjhenge. Saath mein relevant official instructions aur frequently asked questions bhi dekhenge. Ye Part 1 hai. Jahan official wording ya current position clear nahi hai, wahan hum caution batayenge. Claim se pehle latest applicable official orders verify karein.

Rule 1: In rules ka naam hai Central Civil Services, Leave Travel Concession Rules, 1988. Rule 1 sub rule 2 kehta hai ki ye Official Gazette mein publication ki date se force mein aayenge. Teen May 1988 ka notification hai, lekin Gazette publication ki exact date independently confirm nahi hui hai. Isliye exam mein rule ki wording yaad rakhein: date of publication in the Official Gazette.

Content ki currency samajhna zaroori hai. DoPT ki 2025 guidelines aur FAQs ko reference banaya gaya hai. Gazette publication aur baad ke sabhi amendments ka complete check pending hai. Dependency benchmark aur special dispensation ke liye claim date par applicable latest orders verify karein. Rule 6 ki wording mein ambiguity hai, jise hum aage clearly discuss karenge.

Rule 1 sub rule 3 mein chaar covered categories hain. Pehli category: Union ke affairs ke connection mein civil services aur posts par appointed persons, including Defence Services ke civilian government servants. Doosri: State Government employees jo Central Government mein deputation par hain. Teesri: contract par appointed persons. Chauthi: retirement ke baad re-employed persons. Aakhri teen categories ke liye Rule 2 ki conditions bhi dekhein.

Rule 1 sub rule 4 mein seven exclusions hain. Part-time employees, casual aur daily-rated employees, aur contingencies se paid persons. Railway servants, Armed Forces ke members, Indian Missions abroad ke local recruits, aur specified other travel concessions paane wale persons. Railway servants ke liye 2018 ka ek separate exception hai, lekin uski conditions apply hoti hain. Exception ko automatic mat samjhein.

Applicability ke related notes bhi important hain. Autonomous body ka officer Centre mein deputation ke dauraan temporary Government servant ki tarah treat ho sakta hai; applicable conditions verify karein. Industrial aur work-charged staff ke liye regular leave entitlement ka test dekhein. DoPT guidelines ka disclaimer kehta hai: contradiction ya imprecision ho to relevant original order prevail karega.

Rule 2 mein specified categories ke liye one year continuous service aur likely continuance certificate ki conditions hain. Hometown LTC ke liye do saal aur any place in India LTC ke liye chaar saal ki likely service ka certificate relevant hai. Rule mein periods date of joining se gine jaate hain. Appropriate authority certificate aur case ki baaki conditions check karti hai. Rule 7 ki alag admissibility conditions bhi verify karein.

Rule 2 sub rule 2: contract ek saal ke baad extend ho, to total contract duration ko relevant conditions ke saath dekha jaata hai. Sub rule 3: retirement ke turant baad bina break re-employment ho, to re-employed service previous service ke saath continuous maani jaati hai. Lekin concession tabhi admissible hogi jab retirement ke bina bhi admissible hoti. Re-employment se used block automatically reset nahi hota.

Rule 3 LTC ko Government servant aur eligible family tak extend karta hai. Rule 4 mein important definitions hain. Place in India mein Indian territory ke andar ki jagah included hai. Controlling Officer ka reference Supplementary Rule 191 se hai. Hometown employee declare karta hai aur Controlling Officer accept karta hai. Shortest direct route ka reference Supplementary Rule 30 aur applicable orders se hai.

Part 1 ka quick recap. Rules ka commencement Official Gazette publication se linked hai. Rule 1 mein covered categories, exclusions aur relevant exceptions hain. Rule 2 mein specified service aur certificate conditions hain. Rules 3 aur 4 employee, family aur definitions ko cover karte hain. Agle part mein family ki detailed definition, dependency aur official FAQs dekhenge.
